about.p1: We are Coast Parfum, your trusted premium perfumery born in Concón, V Región de Valparaíso. We believe the world's finest fragrances shouldn't be an unreachable luxury.
about.p2: Every perfume in our collection is 100% original, carefully selected from the finest designer houses and most exclusive Arabic perfumeries. We deliver them to your door throughout the Valparaíso region.
about.value2text: Careful selection from the finest houses
about.value3text: We reach all of V Región de Valparaíso
about.value4text: Expert advice to find your perfect scent

shipping.title: SHIPPING & PICKUP
shipping.subtitle: Only within V Región de Valparaíso
shipping.deliveryText: We ship throughout V Región de Valparaíso. We reach Valparaíso, Viña del Mar, Concón, Quilpué, Villa Alemana, Reñaca, Olmué, Casablanca, Quillota and more. Shipping costs are coordinated with you via WhatsApp.
shipping.pickupText: If you're near Concón, pick up your order at no extra cost. We coordinate the day and time that suits you best, directly via WhatsApp.
shipping.note: We currently only ship within V Región de Valparaíso. For special inquiries, contact us.

contact.subtitle: Write to us and we'll help you choose the ideal perfume for yourself or as a gift. Personalized attention, immediate response.
contact.hours: We respond Monday to Saturday · 9:00 AM – 9:00 PM

footer.slogan: Discover your essence. We live perfume.
